description: Environment variables for the mobile app (MeetSweet-mobile/). Copy .env.example to .env.local and set values. EXPO_PUBLIC_* vars are inlined at build time by Expo.

EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL.notes: Origin of the Next.js backend. All API calls go to <this>/api/<route> via services/api.ts. Default in .env.example is the production origin.

EXPO_PUBLIC_DOMAIN.notes: Replit dev domain; injected by the dev script for tunnel/proxy setups.

EXPO_PUBLIC_REPL_ID.notes: Replit repl id; injected by the dev script.

EXPO_PUBLIC_PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY.notes: Paystack public key if the client-side Paystack SDK flows are used for wallet funding.

build_time_note: Because EXPO_PUBLIC_* values are inlined at export/build time, changing EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL requires rebuilding the app/web export — not just restarting the dev server. For dev, `pnpm dev` sets EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL / REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_HOSTNAME from the Replit environment automatically.
